sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 660. Success value 100. 3x physical damage that pierces through damage reduction/reflection effects (Water).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Increases critical hit chance by 50% for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Boosts critical hit Ability Power by 100 for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases Critical Assault (increases Ability Power when performing critical hits) buff limit by 50 for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases Unison gauge gains by 2 for 120 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Barracks for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] increases all stats by 100%; [Special] increases critical hit chance by 100%; [Special] increases physical/magic attack Ability success value by 40; [Special] reduces cooldown time by 50%. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
-Applies Water Qualia (increases all stats by 100%, increases water elemental attack by 10, increases water elemental defense by 150, and nullifies Frozen and Paralysis) to the allied Field for 120 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 and stat slot 2 by 35000
Fire and Water Defense from Unison Damage +600
